original_title: GTA 6 is the highest-rated game of all time
summary_en: Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially claimed the top spot on Metacritic, achieving a score that no other game in history has managed. This monumental achievement cements its place as a generation-defining title.
ai_analysis: GTA 6's unprecedented Metacritic score signals a new benchmark for open-world design and narrative ambition in the gaming industry.

en.title: GTA 6 Shatters Records, Becomes Metacritic's Highest-Rated Game Ever
en.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially claimed the top spot on Metacritic, achieving a score that no other game in history has managed. This monumental achievement cements its place as a generation-defining title.
en.body:
The wait for **Grand Theft Auto 6** has been agonizingly long, spanning over a decade, but the initial critical reception suggests it has exceeded even the loftiest expectations. Early reviews are pouring in, and the consensus is clear: **Rockstar Games** has delivered a masterpiece. According to reports, **GTA 6** has climbed to the pinnacle of Metacritic's all-time rankings, boasting an astounding average score of 99 based on 98 reviews. This places it not only as the highest-rated game ever but also as a direct peer to timeless classics like **The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time**.

This incredible feat is particularly noteworthy given the increasing difficulty for games to achieve such stellar scores in the modern era. As noted by some industry observers, reaching a perfect 99 or 98 with over 100 reviews is far more challenging today than it was for games with fewer reviews decades ago. **Rockstar** has consistently pushed the boundaries with its titles, with previous entries like **GTA IV** (98) and **GTA V** and **Red Dead Redemption 2** (both 97) coming close but never quite breaking the 99 threshold. **GTA 6** has now achieved what many believed was no longer possible in today's competitive and maturing gaming landscape.

## A New Benchmark for Open Worlds

The overwhelming praise for **GTA 6** highlights **Rockstar Games'** unparalleled ability to craft immersive, detailed, and engaging open worlds. While specific details about the game's narrative and gameplay mechanics are still being uncovered, the critical reception points to a title that excels across the board. Reviewers have lauded its ambition, depth, and technical prowess, suggesting that **Rockstar** has once again redefined what is possible in interactive entertainment. The game's success isn't just a win for **Rockstar**; it's a powerful statement about the enduring potential for innovation and artistic achievement in AAA gaming.

## The Fan Verdict is Still Out

While critics are in near-unanimous agreement, the true measure of **GTA 6's** legacy will ultimately be determined by its massive global fanbase. The anticipation surrounding this release has been immense, fueled by years of speculation and a few tantalizing glimpses of gameplay. Fans have been eagerly awaiting confirmation of its quality, and this critical acclaim provides strong validation for their patience. The coming weeks and months will reveal how the player community embraces **GTA 6** and whether it can maintain its status as a beloved entry in the storied **Grand Theft Auto** franchise.

## What's Next

With **GTA 6** now officially the highest-rated game of all time, all eyes are on **Rockstar Games** and the official release date for PC players, which has not yet been announced. Further details regarding post-launch content and potential expansions are also expected in the future.

content_raw: Reviews for Grand Theft Auto 6 are slowly rolling out, and it no game in history matches it. Our wonderful Scott Duwe gave the game a perfect 10 , saying it is both the best GTA and one of the best games of our generation, and if MetaCritic is anything to go by, everyone seems to agree. As things stand, GTA 6 is MetaCritic’s top-rated game of all time, with an average score of 99 out of 98 reviewers. Not a single review gave the game a negative or mixed score, and almost all of them dished out perfect 10s. Whichever way you cut it, it seems GTA 6 is genuinely one of the best games ever made, and it’s only matched by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (the original) from 30 years ago. Image via Rockstar Games Make sure you go and check out our sister-site, GTA 6 Bible for all your GTA 6 needs. Dethroning a legend is not easy, and Rockstar has been trying hard to do it for over two decades now. Each of its games came within a hair’s distance, hovering around 96 or 97 or even 98, but never truly crossing the threshold into 99 and above. Now, though, it’s done what many, myself included, thought to be impossible. Things have irrevocably changed compared to Zelda ‘s time, and perfect games, if such even exist, have been relegated to mere memory. Modern gaming discourse constantly thinks about what used to be, and the future kept contracting and collapsing into itself, disallowing hope for AAA greatness. Rockstar has finally changed that. There still is hope for gaming, there is room for great titles and innovation and depth of gameplay and stories are yet to be told that’ll echo in eternity. Ocarina of Time showed what was possible at the end of the last century, and GTA 6 proved it still to be within reach as we cross the first quarter of the third millennium.
